prompt: Create one original square full-bleed painted fantasy RPG spell icon for Magic Circle against Chaos, intended to be legible at 128 pixels. Approved family: painted-magical; broad brushwork, dark atmospheric edges, luminous spell center, no graphic badge border or UI frame. Concept is outward protection for a group: three small medieval adventurers stand inside a visible circular ring of warm light on the ground; four stout ivory-gold geometric buttresses rise evenly around them and join into a clear symmetrical protective vault. The four straight pillars and vault are the dominant silhouette, representing orderly lawful stability against chaotic swirling shards outside. The ring is an emanation around the group, never a trap or binding diagram. Make this silhouette recognizably different from a single shield, sunburst dome, crescent shell, or organic spiraling ribbons. Brushed stone, pale amber gold and deep slate-blue atmosphere, a few readable jagged red sparks deflected outside. Figures are simplified small silhouettes; no finely detailed faces. Composition fills most of image with one coherent protective group motif. No lettering, runes, writing, logos, monograms, checkers, parchment, decorative frame, photographic realism, or flat vector outlines. Original visual identity, not existing game art. Output a single square 1024x1024 painted image.
